title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 115 Nicol Avenue in Thomasville, Alabama, as the "Postmaster Robert Ingram Post Office".
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 115 Nicol Avenue in Thomasville, Alabama, as the "Postmaster Robert Ingram Post Office."

summary.headline: A 2020 law renamed the Thomasville, Alabama post office at 115 Nicol Avenue in honor of former postmaster Robert Ingram.
summary.what_it_does: The law officially names the United States Postal Service facility at 115 Nicol Avenue in Thomasville, Alabama, the "Postmaster Robert Ingram Post Office." It is a naming measure only. It does not change mail service, postal rules, or the building's operations.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 17, 2020, and the new name applies from that date.
